hooks.command: c=$(cat ~/.claude/.comment-nudge 2>/dev/null || echo 0); c=$((c+1)); echo "$c" > ~/.claude/.comment-nudge; [ $((c % 5)) -eq 0 ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Comment policy: minimal — comments only for non-obvious constraints; no narration, banners, or boilerplate docstrings."}}' || true
